turns.assessment: The fault is isolated to the 68.4 km span between the second and third amplifiers on S07–S16. Both directional OSCs were lost simultaneously, while the upstream amplifiers remained normal and the downstream amplifiers lost input and output power. Simultaneous total loss on both fibres strongly indicates a duplex cable cut rather than an amplifier, ROADM, or channel-specific failure.

proposals.rationale: E7 is the S07→S16 representation of the 68.4 km physical span; O13 and the reciprocal O14 show OSC loss on both fibres. Upstream amp0/amp1 powers were unchanged, while amp2 and all downstream channels lost light, precisely localizing a hard break to this span.
An extreme simultaneous loss increase could suppress both payload and OSC, but complete coincident loss in both directions is more characteristic of a cable cut.
